args.query: traffic fatalities FARS motor vehicle deaths

args.topic: traffic fatalities trend lowest since year

sql: SELECT "year", SUM(fatalities) AS deaths, COUNT(*) AS crashes FROM transport.fatal_crashes GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"
SELECT "year", SUM(fatalities) AS h1_deaths FROM transport.fatal_crashes WHERE month(crash_date) <= 6 AND "year" >= 2009 GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"
